rules.statement: A partition decree entered without any investigation of title does not have the conclusive effect provided by section 9 of the Partition Ordinance, but a decree entered after a defective or inadequate investigation of title is still conclusive as long as it has not been set aside on an appeal in the same action.
rules.supporting_quote: Although a partition decree entered without any investigation of title does not have the conclusive effect provided by section 9 of the Partition Ordinance, a decree entered after a defective or inadequate investigation of title is conclusive, as long as it has not been set aside on an appeal in the same action.
